title: pbs-parity-trace/1
description: Response of POST /__parity/exec: the real HTTP response the server produced for the envelope plus everything it observed on the way. Both implementations must emit every top-level member (empty arrays/maps, never omitted).

http_in.description: The inbound request as the server's handler chain received it (stage http.in).

http_response.description: The response written by the handler chain (stage http.response). If the handler panicked, status is 500 and notes contains 'panic: ...'.

stages.description: stage_id -> key -> entry. key is '_' for unkeyed stages, otherwise the bidder, seat or 'bidder#call' named by the stage's keyed_by in stages.json.

stage_status.description: Status of every stage registered in stages.json: captured, not_reached, or unimplemented (Rust only: no equivalent capture point yet).

http_out.description: Outbound calls. Filled by the server in inline mode (wire=false); in oracle mode the runner merges the oracle's wire captures (wire=true).

metrics_delta.description: Prometheus series that changed while the case ran, sorted by name then labels.

StageEntry.description: One recorded value. json is the semantic value; raw is the exact bytes the implementation marshaled (raw_b64 when they are not UTF-8), so lexical differences survive the outer document's re-encoding. errors/warnings are null when the stage records no error list and [] when it recorded an empty one. writes counts how often the key was recorded (last write wins). seq is the session-wide sequence number of the last write.

Decision.description: One consulted decision point. source is envelope when the value came from envelope.decisions, rng otherwise.

MetricDelta.description: Change of one Prometheus series. counter/gauge/untyped: delta is the value change, count_delta and bucket_deltas are null. histogram/summary: delta is the sum change, count_delta the observation-count change, bucket_deltas (histogram only) the non-zero cumulative bucket changes keyed by the exposition-format 'le' value.

AnalyticsRecord.description: One analytics Log*Object call. object is a language-neutral projection: for auction/amp/video {status, errors[ErrorRecord], request (BidRequest as the handler left it, never rebuilt), response, account_id, start_time_set, hook_outcomes, seat_non_bid, ...}; for cookie_sync/setuid {status, errors, ...}; for notification {request, account_id}.
